newsitem.title: UK: Rover denies Chrysler car deal report.
newsitem.headline: Rover denies Chrysler car deal report.

text.p: Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG's Rover unit on Monday denied a British newspaper report that it planned an alliance with Chrysler Corp to make a new range of cars in Britain and the U.S. "We refute it totally. There's no truth in it at all. It's total speculation, and we deny it totally," said Rover spokesman Denis Chick.
The Sunday Times newspaper had said that a deal could come in the next few months.
But Chick said the only alliance between BMW Group and Chrysler was their recent agreement to establish a joint venture to produce small car engines.
Engines produced by the venture will be used in Rover cars and the Chrysler Neon, which is made in the U.S.
